name: Imran Khan Cancer Appeal USA

rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1994, Imran Khan Cancer Appeal, Inc. (IKCA) serves as a vital financial lifeline for cancer treatment in Pakistan, specifically supporting the Shaukat Khanum Memorial Cancer Hospital and Research Centre. The organization operates with a high degree of financial focus, reporting <cite id="3">$17,974,012 in total revenue</cite> for the 2023 fiscal year. Its primary mission is to <cite id="2">provide free cancer treatment</cite> to patients who cannot afford medical costs, bridging a critical gap in Pakistan's healthcare infrastructure. The charity maintains a <cite id="1">95/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting a strong commitment to accountability and leadership. While the organization demonstrates exceptional financial efficiency, with a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 97.4%</cite>, it maintains a lean governance structure. IKCA is <cite id="2">verified as zakat-eligible</cite>, allowing Muslim donors to fulfill their religious obligations by supporting the 'fuqara' (poor) and 'masakin' (needy) who are battling cancer. The charity has shown consistent growth, evidenced by a <cite id="3">three-year revenue CAGR of 20.4%</cite>, which allows it to expand its clinical and diagnostic services in a region where specialized oncology care is often inaccessible to the underserved.
